'''Shchi''' ({{lang-rus|щи|p=ɕːi|a=Ru-щи.ogg}}, sometimes transliterated as šči) is a [[Russian cuisine|Russian]]-style [[cabbage soup]]. When [[sauerkraut]] is used instead, the soup is called '''sour shchi''', while soups based on [[sorrel]], [[spinach]], [[Urtica dioica|nettle]], and similar plants are called [[green shchi]] ({{lang-rus|зелёные щи|p=zʲɪˈlʲɵnɨje ɕːi}}). In the past, the term ''sour shchi'' was also used to refer to a drink, a variation of [[kvass]], which was unrelated to the soup.<ref>{{cite book|language=ru|chapter=Щи|chapter-url=http://dic.academic.ru/dic.nsf/ogegova/272666|year=1949–1992|title=[[Dictionary of the Russian Language (Ozhegov)]]|author=S.I.
